int_name: N LAWRENCE ST & W OLNEY AVE

result.summary: The image shows a narrow one-way residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though the right side is constrained by trees. There are no marked crosswalks or visible curb ramps at the immediate corner, and parked vehicles create potential sightline obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped transitions makes the sidewalk inaccessible for people with mobility devices or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corner to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides but lacks basic crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps at the visible intersection. The presence of sharrows indicates shared use with bicycles, but the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety and accessibility.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: No designated or marked area for pedestrians to cross the street at the intersection.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The corner lacks ADA-compliant curb ramps, creating a barrier for people with mobility devices.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at the intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks but lacks essential crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control devices. The wide, uncontrolled intersection and parked vehicles near the corners create significant visibility and accessibility challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalks terminate in vertical curbs without ramps, creating a significant barrier for individuals with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the side street block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street

interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all intersection corners.
